reviews.t: The larger the head & the thinner the hair..the more the metal pressure shall hurt your scalp.
reviews.x: Really pretty. If you have curly, dark and short hair (like me) the ears will appear smaller but your poofy soft hair will work as comfortable pillows when the harsh metal side pieces start to dig into your scalp with it's rough pressure.  Honestly... I can't wear this for more than  a hour when I have my hair straightened or tied. Really hurts the tender area above and a front of my ears.  Also... the golden one kind of broke after a few weeks of use. Ears detached from the band. I'm not upset-

reviews.t: Popular fashion accessory, affordable and cute
reviews.x: So the silver one fit fine, but the gold one was tight and I had to stretch it out to fit. It was actually causing me pain like my head was in a vice. I can't guarantee that any others you might purchase yourself may or may not have the same issue. It's easy enough to remedy. Bottom line, these are awesome and look good. The ears were also more upright than the photo shows, but they look better in person.

These are comfy, they don't hurt after hours of wearing. Even my 8 year old loves them and has no complaints about pain either. Some headbands tend to make your head hurt, behind the ears from the pressure, not these.

Very cute, although a bit larger ears than I expected. As with all metal headbands, they hurt my head after a bit, but the metal is bendable, so maybe I can work with it. Overall very shiny and pretty.
One of the headbands arrived broken and they don’t allow returns. The other headband had both ears on, but they were off center. This is such a cheaply made product! Don’t waste your money

Hands down the cutest headbands I have ever gotten at a price so cheap!! These headbands feel so luxurious! I personally use them when I do makeup or doing my skincare routine. Still so shocked that they were only around $5!!! They fit snug enough to be comfortable but will not slide around like most headbands. I honestly was expecting cheap plastic headbands that are only gilded to be shiny, but I was pleasantly surprised to find out that the headbands are of great quality! Very impressed!

One of the headbands broke the first time my daughter wore it. I've seen much better quality. These are obviously cheaply made.  Update: Mudder proactively contacted me regarding the broken headbands and immediately sent out a new pair. New ones are in perfect condition and my daughter loves them!  Thank you!

As a serious cat lover, my daughter loves them. She begged me to buy them earlier last year... They add a hint of "bling" in a humorous, offbeat way. They've lasted all this time without anything coming apart--a great buy.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the headbands as very cute and adorable.
Several reviewers mention discomfort or pain from the metal band, especially with long wear or a tight fit.
Some reviewers report durability issues, such as ears coming off or seams breaking.
A few reviewers note the headbands fit well or can be stretched to adjust tightness.
One reviewer praises the seller's customer service for sending a replacement after a problem.
